description:
Earlier this year we released the Spelljammer, a canti brake randonneuring frameset. Through thousands of miles of test riding that model I decided I wanted to create my ideal “forever” version. The key points were to be a titanium frame, for the ultimate in lightweight performance with excellent vibration damping, and disc brakes for all-weather confidence. To execute the vision we used our excellent Wayfinder fork and a butted titanium tubeset. The geometry is “mid” trail sitting at about 55mm with 40mm tires.

For the show build we partnered with our friends at Sim Works to spec out and accessorize with items from their outstanding catalog. The silver high polished parts and accessories complete the vision. A bike that is at once both thoroughly modern and yet aesthetically timeless.

I'm honestly not sure how much this thing would cost at retail price but a solid guess is around $12k. As we built it without a customer in mind, we're selling it at a discounted price of $9k.

Build Spec
Frame -Wilde Titanium Rando
Fork - Wilde - Wayfinder
Headset: Wilde X Cane Creek 110 ZS
Hubs - White Industries Rear / Son Dynamo Front
Light - Sinewave Beacon Painted to Match - Not present in these photos but will come wired and ready
Rims - Velocity / Sim Works Standalone
Tires - Rene Herse Barlow Pass
Crank - White Industries
Derailleurs - Shimano GRX
Shifters - Shimano GRX
Bars - Nitto
Stem - Sim Works Anna Lee
Post - Sim Works Froggy
Saddle - Brooks
Brakes - Shimano GRX
Rack - Sim Works Obento
Fenders - Sim Works Smooth 51
*Bag Not Included*

SAFETY

Please read the bicycle owners manual before riding. This is important for safe operation of your new bike. Bicycle Owners Manual
